## CU-4 Pump Controller - Firmware Release Notes

This document records every released firmware version for the CU-4 controller, including default communication settings and safety parameters.

## 2. Firmware version 4.0

Firmware 4.0 was released on 11 May 2023. Key change: this version added Modbus TCP support.

In firmware 4.0 the watchdog timeout is 2000 ms, the controller supports up to 96 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 9600.

## 3. Firmware version 4.1

Firmware 4.1 was released on 03 August 2023. Key change: this version introduced dry-run protection.

In firmware 4.1 the watchdog timeout is 2000 ms, the controller supports up to 128 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 115200.

## 4. Firmware version 4.2

Firmware 4.2 was released on 22 October 2023. Key change: this version added BACnet/IP gateway mode.

In firmware 4.2 the watchdog timeout is 1000 ms, the controller supports up to 48 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 57600.

## 5. Firmware version 4.3

Firmware 4.3 was released on 22 December 2023. Key change: this version reduced boot time by 40 percent.

In firmware 4.3 the watchdog timeout is 1000 ms, the controller supports up to 96 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 57600.

## 6. Firmware version 4.4

Firmware 4.4 was released on 18 February 2024. Key change: this version added secure boot with signed images.

In firmware 4.4 the watchdog timeout is 500 ms, the controller supports up to 16 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 19200.

## 7. Firmware version 4.5

Firmware 4.5 was released on 11 May 2024. Key change: this version introduced PID auto-tuning.

In firmware 4.5 the watchdog timeout is 500 ms, the controller supports up to 16 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 38400.

## 8. Firmware version 4.6

Firmware 4.6 was released on 12 August 2024. Key change: this version added OPC UA server.

In firmware 4.6 the watchdog timeout is 250 ms, the controller supports up to 16 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 9600.

## 9. Firmware version 4.7

Firmware 4.7 was released on 11 November 2024. Key change: this version fixed watchdog reset loop under high bus load.

In firmware 4.7 the watchdog timeout is 500 ms, the controller supports up to 64 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 9600.

## 10. Firmware version 4.8

Firmware 4.8 was released on 28 January 2025. Key change: this version added multi-pump cascade control.

In firmware 4.8 the watchdog timeout is 1500 ms, the controller supports up to 16 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 9600.

## 11. Firmware version 4.9

Firmware 4.9 was released on 18 May 2025. Key change: this version introduced predictive bearing-wear alarm.

In firmware 4.9 the watchdog timeout is 500 ms, the controller supports up to 64 fieldbus nodes, and the default RS-485 baud rate is 57600.
